FACT No. 1 🧠
The most important fact about your brain

Your brain changes every time you learn.

Scientists call it NEUROPLASTICITY. Your brain has about 86 billion neurons. When you learn something new, neurons build a new path. The more you practise, the wider the path gets. Like a trail in a forest! 🌲
🌱

1 time

a narrow little trail

🛣️

10 times

a wide road

💪

Brain = muscle

train it and it gets stronger

FACT No. 2 🤖
Artificial intelligence (AI)

AI is a system that does what brains can do:

📚

Learns

from examples, just like you

🧩

Solves

problems step by step

💾

Remembers

millions of facts

💡

Thinks and creates

texts, pictures, games

But AI learned from people. The stronger your brain, the better you control AI, instead of AI controlling you. 🎮
FACT No. 3 🎯
🎮
Learning to learn

You can train your brain. Always.

That’s why you can learn to beat any challenge and come up with new solutions. Maths, drawing, football, coding: it’s all training.
LEVEL 2! ⬆️
